<!-- this list is auto-generated by https://github.com/goreleaser/sponsors -->
{{ define "tier" -}}
{{- $sponsors := index . "sponsors" -}}
{{- if $sponsors -}}
{{- $size := index . "size" -}}
<h3 align="center">{{ index . "name" }}</h3>

<p align="center">
{{- range $sponsors }}
  <a href="{{ .Website }}" target="_blank" rel="noopener sponsored"><img src="{{ .LogoWithSize $size }}" alt="{{ .Name }}" width="{{ $size }}"/></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;
{{- end }}
</p>

{{ end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- template "tier" (dict "name" "TUI Innovator" "size" 160 "sponsors" (index .ByTier "innovator")) -}}
{{- template "tier" (dict "name" "TUI Visionary" "size" 128 "sponsors" (index .ByTier "visionary")) -}}
{{- template "tier" (dict "name" "TUI Power User" "size" 50 "sponsors" (index .ByTier "power-user")) -}}
{{- template "tier" (dict "name" "TUI Backer" "size" 40 "sponsors" (index .ByTier "backer")) -}}
